owner_approval: The owner approved on 2026-11-10, in chat, a separate task to obtain the SEC EDGAR copies of the Form 10-Q for the third quarter of 2026 and of the two releases, if they were filed as 8-K exhibits, including the metadata needed to locate and verify them, with no paid calls.
scope: Step 3 of 3: one GET of each document named by the folder indexes of step 2 (fcx-sec-index-02): the 10-Q's primary document, and each 8-K's cover document and release exhibit. The covers are retained to verify each exhibit's designation.

access_rules.sec: https://www.sec.gov/os/accessing-edgar-data: automated access must declare a contact in the User-Agent and stay below ten requests per second. The contact is read at request time from the user-level SECOND_ORDER_FEED_CONTACT and is written nowhere.
